rows.note: Priority is Low because it represents preventive maintenance before onset of rains.

rows.text: காற்றாற்று வெள்ள நீர் வடிகால் ஆக்கிரமிக்கப்பட்டு தடுப்பு சுவர் கட்டப்பட்டுள்ளது.
rows.summary: Stormwater drainage channel encroached with a retaining wall constructed, posing potential flooding or obstruction issues.
rows.note: Priority is High because obstruction of primary stormwater channels creates massive flood vulnerabilities.

rows.text: Drain iron grill grate stolen overnight at corner of Gandhi Chowk, leaving an open rectangular hole.
rows.summary: Drain iron grill grate stolen, leaving an open hole at the corner of Gandhi Chowk.
rows.note: Priority is High due to severe vehicle tire trap and nighttime pedestrian fall risk.

rows.text: Stagnant green water in open roadside ditch breeding thousands of mosquitoes near primary clinic.
rows.summary: Stagnant green water in an open ditch near a primary clinic is breeding mosquitoes, posing a health risk.
rows.note: Priority is High: mosquito breeding near a clinic is exactly the disease-carrying-conditions case the priority rubric calls high.

rows.text: Drain outlet pipe into main canal has minor vegetation overgrowth at mouth.
rows.summary: Minor vegetation overgrowth at the drain outlet pipe into the main canal.
rows.note: Priority is Low as weed growth has not yet caused significant hydraulic backwater.

rows.text: Pack of aggressive stray dogs chasing two-wheelers and biting school children near gate 4 every morning.
rows.summary: Pack of aggressive stray dogs chasing vehicles and biting school children near gate 4 every morning.
rows.note: Priority is High due to active physical bite injuries and severe rabies hazard to children.

rows.text: Chemical fogging for dengue mosquitoes not conducted in Ward 18 for over two months.
rows.summary: Chemical fogging for dengue mosquitoes has not been conducted in Ward 18 for over two months.
rows.note: Priority is Low because routine periodic fogging request is an administrative sanitation schedule.

rows.text: Public urinal opposite main bus stand overflowing with urine onto pavement, severe unbearable stink.
rows.summary: Public urinal opposite the main bus stand is overflowing onto the pavement, causing a severe stink.
rows.note: Priority is Medium as severe public insanitary conditions degrade public space without biohazard lockdown.

rows.text: बेवारस जनावरे मुख्य रस्त्यावर बसल्यामुळे वाहतूक कोंडी होत आहे आणि अपघात घडत आहेत.
rows.summary: Stray cattle on the main road are causing traffic jams and accidents.
rows.note: Priority is Medium as cattle on roads cause transit delays and vehicular dodging without fatal pileups.

rows.text: Illegal open meat stall slaughtering chickens on open footpath without health clearance or drainage.
rows.summary: An illegal open meat stall is slaughtering chickens on a footpath without health clearance or drainage, creating potential disease-carrying conditions.
rows.note: Priority is High because unhygienic unregulated animal slaughtering generates acute disease outbreak risks.

rows.text: Swarm of honeybees formed large hive on children playground swing set frame.
rows.summary: A large swarm of honeybees has formed a hive on the children's playground swing set frame, posing an immediate stinging hazard.
rows.note: Priority is High due to severe sting attack threat directly on children's play equipment.

rows.text: Public park benches covered in wild pigeon droppings and bird feathers.
rows.summary: Public park benches are covered in bird droppings and feathers, presenting a cosmetic maintenance issue.
rows.note: Priority is Low as soiled public park seating is a routine cleaning maintenance matter.

rows.text: Dead rat lying dried up on pedestrian overbridge stairs.
rows.summary: A dead rat is lying on the pedestrian overbridge stairs.
rows.note: Priority is Low as minor small-animal carcass on stairs requires routine sweep pickup.

rows.text: Local sweet shop has extended permanent concrete ramp 6 feet onto the public road, blocking car passage.
rows.summary: An extended concrete ramp from a sweet shop is encroaching 6 feet onto the public road and blocking car passage.
rows.note: Priority is High: it is currently blocking car passage on a public road right now, regardless of the longer-term enforcement/demolition process needed to remove it.

rows.text: Massive ancient peepal tree uprooted during cyclone, completely crushing car and blocking hospital road.
rows.summary: An uprooted tree has completely crushed a car and is blocking hospital road access.
rows.note: Priority is Critical because emergency access to hospital is blocked and active property damage occurred.

rows.text: Illegal advertising flex banners erected across pedestrian footpath blocking sightlines at intersection.
rows.summary: Illegal advertising flex banners erected across pedestrian footpath blocking sightlines at an intersection.
rows.note: Priority is Low as unauthorized hoarding removal is a standard municipal enforcement action.

rows.text: Street vendor pushing cart occupying corner spot near park gate during evening hours.
rows.summary: Street vendor occupying corner spot near park gate during evening hours.
rows.note: Priority is Low because transient hawkers create minor pedestrian friction without physical structures.

rows.text: Deep foundation excavation for commercial complex next door causing boundary wall of residential society to crack and tilt.
rows.summary: Deep excavation at a neighboring commercial site is causing the residential society boundary wall to crack and tilt.
rows.note: Priority is Critical due to structural destabilization threatening immediate building collapse.

rows.text: Bougainvillea plant branches from private bungalow garden hanging 1 foot over compound wall into alley.
rows.summary: Private bungalow garden branches hanging over compound wall into an alley, causing minor cosmetic/clearance encroachment without blocking access or posing danger.
rows.note: Priority is Low as mild ornamental overgrowth causes minimal inconvenience.

rows.text: શેરીમાં આવેલું ભૂગર્ભ ગટરનું ઢાંકણું તૂટી ગયું છે અને વાહનો તેમાં ફસાઈ રહ્યા છે.
rows.summary: Broken underground drainage manhole cover is causing vehicles to get stuck.
rows.note: Priority is High because a broken sewer lid on an active street directly traps vehicles and injures drivers.

rows.text: ਗਲੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਲਾਈਟਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਬੰਦ ਪਈਆਂ ਹਨ, ਰਾਤ ਨੂੰ ਚੋਰੀ ਦਾ ਡਰ ਬਣਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
rows.summary: All street lights have been off for a week, causing fear of theft at night.
rows.note: Priority is High: every light on the street out for a week is a whole-area outage, the rubric's own high-tier example.

rows.text: Water pipeline work completed 1 month ago but road was never restored; now muddy slush traps cars whenever water tanker passes.
rows.summary: Road restoration not completed after pipeline work, leaving muddy slush that traps vehicles.
rows.note: Priority is Medium and confidence is 0.49 due to overlapping responsibility between Water Board excavation and PWD resurfacing.

rows.text: Urgent loan approved up to 10 Lakhs with zero collateral! Call instant finance desk at 9123456780.
rows.summary: Spam message offering an instant loan.
rows.note: Priority is Low because non-civic commercial promotional spam is assigned the minimum priority tier.

rows.text: Strange loud rumbling noise heard underground every 10 minutes near the circular market square.
rows.summary: Strange loud rumbling noise heard underground periodically near the circular market square.
rows.note: Priority is Medium and confidence is 0.34 due to ambiguous physical source (metro boring vs pipeline cavitation vs geological).

rows.text: Municipal staff behavior was very rude when I visited office for birth certificate counter.
rows.summary: Complaint regarding rude behavior of municipal staff at the birth certificate counter.
rows.note: Priority is Low because administrative staff demeanor is an internal governance issue with no emergency safety impact.
